construct: Pathogenic variants in the X-linked GLA gene reduce lysosomal alpha-galactosidase A activity. Inadequate degradation of globotriaosylceramide and related glycosphingolipids causes progressive lysosomal accumulation in vascular, renal, cardiac, and neural tissues.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: A young man with acroparesthesias, angiokeratomas, hypohidrosis, proteinuria, and corneal verticillata has classic Fabry disease.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Hurler syndrome can cause corneal opacity, but it produces a different multisystem phenotype with coarse features and developmental/skeletal findings; it does not match the characteristic X-linked Fabry cluster.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: The phenotype plus alpha-galactosidase-A/Gb3 disease pattern uniquely distinguishes Fabry from the other listed lysosomal storage disorders.
